# Amazon results: model setups and the professor's questions (amazon)

Pilot budget (LightGBM, logistic regression, CatBoost; 10 tuning trials; seed 555), 3 grouped split repeats, test PR-AUC of each setup's Model A (no-skill 0.095). Verdict rule, fixed before the runs: **supported** if Δ > 0 on all 3 splits, mean Δ > SD, and the Nadeau–Bengio corrected t-test over the 15 grouped training CV folds gives p < 0.05. Otherwise a positive mean is **not distinguishable from zero** and a negative mean is labelled **worse**; p is two-sided, so a "worse" with p ≥ 0.05 is a lower mean, not a significant drop. Source: docs/RESEARCH_PLAN.md §11 and the results database.

## 2. The professor's questions (2026-10-21)

### Embedding size (and DeepTune)

Training CV (Z1, split 0, without f19; gnnrand averaged over 5 initialisations), PR-AUC by embedding size d:

| d per relation | gnnssl | gnnrand |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | 0.642 | 0.634 |
| 4 | 0.662 | 0.653 |
| 8 | 0.688 | 0.673 |
| 16 | 0.696 | 0.697 |
| 32 | 0.695 | 0.699 |
| 64 | 0.699 | 0.701 |
| raw | 0.696 | 0.702 |

Effective rank of the 64-d embedding (U-P-U / U-S-U / U-V-U): gnnrand 30 / 18 / 18; gnnssl 24 / 7 / 15.

Test, without f19 (Δ vs B):

| Size per relation | E2 (DGI) − B | E3 (untrained) − B |
|---|---|---|
| 8 (default) | +0.130 ± 0.022 (supported, p = 0.0011) | +0.127 ± 0.018 (supported, p = 0.00033) |
| 16 | +0.139 ± 0.027 (supported, p = 0.00038) | +0.121 ± 0.010 (supported, p = 8.7e-05) |
| raw 64 | +0.144 ± 0.028 (supported, p = 7e-05) | no 3-split result |

DeepTune has no label-free reducer for tabular or graph embeddings (its embeddings come from label-trained models; its autoencoder is image-only), so it was not used; an autoencoder in place of PCA (E4) is optional.

## 3. The research questions

### RQ1: how much does the f19 leak drive Amazon results?

- F4, dropping f19 (B without f19 − B all 25): -0.379 ± 0.024 (worse, p = 3.4e-11)
- Graph gain by feature variant (E1 − B / E2 − B):
  - all 25: +0.010 ± 0.008 (supported, p = 0.013) / +0.011 ± 0.002 (not distinguishable from zero, p = 0.09)
  - without f19: +0.163 ± 0.023 (supported, p = 9.7e-06) / +0.130 ± 0.022 (supported, p = 0.0011)
  - without #36: +0.162 ± 0.026 (supported, p = 6e-07) / +0.129 ± 0.034 (supported, p = 6.1e-06)

### RQ2: is the graph gain real structure? (without f19)

- Degree (N1 − B): +0.112 ± 0.024 (supported, p = 0.0003)
- Neighbour columns on a random graph (N2 − N1): -0.025 ± 0.006 (worse, p = 0.1)
- Real structure (E1 − N2): +0.076 ± 0.007 (supported, p = 0.00069)
- Beyond degree (E1 − N1, secondary): +0.051 ± 0.004 (supported, p = 0.0009)

Training-CV probe (split 0): own (B) 0.498; + deg (N1) 0.630; + nbr (E1) 0.719; + nbr, rewired (N2) 0.627.
